epic.name: QA previews: run WL-Universe's on the devops reusable workflow
epic.description:
WL-Universe's PR previews (.github/workflows/qa-preview.yml + scripts/qa/*) are a separate copy of devops's reusable-qa-preview.yml + ci/scripts/qa/*, and the two have drifted: deploy-pr, cleanup-pr and generate-compose differ by 135-231 lines. Fixes land twice or only once (the "runner owns the qa folder" fix had to go into both: r2pen2/devops#15 and WL-Universe). Goal: WL-Universe calls the devops reusable workflow and its scripts/qa copies are deleted.

WL-Universe has features devops lacks; each has to become a generic option in devops first, without changing what bindarr, it and speaker get. Move them one at a time, each step deployable on its own.

items.name: devops QA: per-repo hooks for app catalog, env stubs and extra deploy steps
items.description: Make the reusable workflow and ci/scripts/qa take what WL-Universe hard-codes: its app catalog (scripts/qa/apps.mjs → a catalog file), its env-stub dir, image naming (wl-universe-<app>), and a pre-deploy hook per app (Storybook's read-only CMS key, service-account copy for new v2 sites).

items.name: devops QA: deploy companion services with an app, falling back to :latest
items.description: A static SPA's preview needs wl-cms, wl-auth, wl-forms and site-mail up too, using :pr-N if the PR built one and :latest otherwise (WL's SPA_STATIC_SERVICES + imageTagFor). Generalize as a catalog field ("companions").

items.name: devops QA: CMS isolation (cloned CMS files, prefixed Firestore, read-only prod mounts)
items.description: Port WL's preview isolation: copy prod CMS files per PR (cloneCmsAssets), seed prefixed Firestore collections via the wl-cms image (seedFirestore, CMS_COLLECTION_PREFIX), read-only prod image/SA mounts and the Traefik write isolation from generate-compose, and the matching teardown in cleanup-pr. A preview must never read or write prod data.

items.name: devops QA: optional Lighthouse and feature-liveness jobs
items.description: Move WL's accessibility (Lighthouse) and feature liveness jobs into the reusable workflow behind inputs, off by default for other repos.

items.name: WL-Universe: call devops reusable-qa-preview; delete scripts/qa copies
items.description: Replace qa-preview.yml and qa-preview-cleanup.yml with calls to the devops reusable workflows, delete the duplicated scripts/qa files, and check a preview end to end (content loads, CMS edits stay in the preview, teardown removes everything).
